$comment: The rule-pack format (FLR-T-6.3, rules/README.md): one rule on disk, rules/<pack>/rules/<rule ID>/rule.json. It is the evaluator's rule record (rule.schema.json) with the viewer link required and the full provenance: method, the contributor's certification, the review badge or the unreviewed mark, and lint overrides. tools/build-pack.ts writes the evaluator's minimum provenance (spec/rules 3.12) from it and carries the rest in the rule's extras.packFormat.
title: Floorspec rule on disk
description: A rule record with its viewer link, original-paraphrase certification and full provenance.

citation.title: Citation
citation.description: spec/rules 3.2's citation, with link required: the cited section in the publisher's free public viewer. A link only; nothing is ever fetched from it.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Who verified the rule, against which edition, when and how; who wrote the paraphrase and certified it original; and whether a licensed professional reviewed it.

method.title: Method
method.description: How the verifier read the section: freePublicViewer - read by a person in the publisher's free public viewer; ownedCopy - read in a copy the verifier lawfully holds; synthetic - a synthetic code of an example pack. Never by automated extraction.

certifiedBy.title: Certified by
certifiedBy.description: The contributor who wrote the paraphrase and makes the certification.

certification.title: Certification
certification.description: The certification of rules/CONTRIBUTING.md, by version: the paraphrase, title and notes are the contributor's own original wording, and no code text, table or figure was copied or scraped.

lintOverrides.title: Lint overrides
lintOverrides.description: A heuristic lint finding a reviewer has read and accepted, with their note. Only the verbatim heuristics can be overridden.

review.title: Review
review.description: The reviewed badge (FLR-REQ-104) or the unreviewed mark (FLR-REQ-164). Exactly one.

credential.title: Credential
credential.description: The reviewer's licence: profession and jurisdiction, "Licensed architect (ME)".

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: What the reviewer looked at: the paraphrase, the thresholds, the applicability, the fixtures.
